title: The Final Autopsy
author: Astrid Pemberton
blurb: Petra Brightwater, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
